title: glandularia lipozygioides
intro: Glandularia lipozygioides, commonly known as Mountain Lyre, is a flowering plant native to the Andes mountains in South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Lyre include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of Glandularia lipozygioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
